text_block_list.text: Rose Kingdom had injured herself during training, so I accompanied her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the treatment is complete.
...Forgive me for causing you trouble.
choice_data_list: いえ、大事に至らず、幸いです
choice_data_list_en: No, I'm just glad it didn't turn into anything serious.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Deep down, I didn't think it would amount to much, but...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I thank you for advising me to have it examined,
just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
After all, you fulfilled your duties properly
from your own standing.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Now, it is my turn to fulfill my duties.
—Let us return to training.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern, but a rose does not bloom upon a sickbed.
I must resume... as swiftly as possible.
choice_data_list: 焦って倒れた王もいます
choice_data_list_en: There have been kings who fell from impatience, too.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...A fallen king, is it?
I see. Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
History surely tells of kings who made light
of wounds taken upon the battlefield,
only for it to cost them their lives.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You are telling me to learn from the past, then.
choice_data_list: はい、強靭なウマ娘とはいえ
choice_data_list_en: Yes, even for a resilient Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Compared to ordinary humans, perhaps.
However, complacency is our greatest enemy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Let us rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—I am glad you understand my intentions.
Now, then...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Careless... of me.
It seems I've let it get worse...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Compared to you, who erred on the side of caution to seek treatment,
my own judgment still has much to be desired, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us rest for a while.
I only hope this decision proves to be correct.

With overexertion having backfired,
Rose Kingdom was forced to rest for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Good, there appears to be no issue.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It all comes down to the approach.
If I run while taking care of the injured area...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for complete rest; there are ways to manage.
Just like this.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Just as you are a master of care and conditioning,
a king must be a master of judgment.

Thanks to her sharp judgment,
Rose Kingdom brilliantly overcame the crisis!
